enum.sakuraRunner.defaultMode.0: Prefer a project; fall back only when none is detected.
setting.sakuraRunner.script: Preferred package.json script. Empty offers start, dev and run scripts.
setting.sakuraRunner.projectTask: Existing VS Code task label to run for this project (for example CMake or Java).
setting.sakuraRunner.pythonPath: Python interpreter executable. Empty uses the Python extension, project venv, then PATH.
setting.sakuraRunner.cCompiler: C compiler executable; defaults to gcc or clang.
setting.sakuraRunner.cppCompiler: C++ compiler executable; defaults to g++ or clang++.
setting.sakuraRunner.configurations: Explicit project commands. Executables and arguments are separate; no shell expansion. Variables: ${file}, ${projectDir}, ${workspaceFolder}. Relative executables containing a slash resolve from the project directory. For Windows .cmd wrappers use an existing VS Code task.
setting.sakuraRunner.javaPath: Java executable. Empty uses JAVA_HOME/bin/java, then PATH. Requires JDK 11+ for source files.
setting.sakuraRunner.python.autoActivate: Activate newly created Sakura Atelier Python terminals through the official Python environment manager when available. Does not change official settings or existing terminals.
setting.sakuraAtelier.python.autoActivat: Activate newly created Sakura Atelier Python terminals through the official Python environment manager when available. Does not change official settings or existing terminals.
setting.sakuraAtelier.language: Sakura Atelier UI language. The configuration page and notifications update immediately; static Settings descriptions follow the VS Code display language.
